latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Shop content compliance review skill:

- Enables review and classification of TikTok Shop promotional content for policy compliance.
- Applies official TikTok Shop Seller University guidance to videos, scripts, captions, images, and promotions.
- Flags misleading claims, product mismatches, unoriginality, AI disclosure issues, prohibited edits, health or wellness risks, giveaways, gambling, IP risks, and platform-safety concerns.
- Produces structured verdicts with reasons, policy references, and safer rewrite suggestions.
- Prioritizes conservative interpretation and directs users to verify unclear or conflicting cases with live policy sources.
